Self-service KYC

Grounded in eight months of double-diamond research.Ik was eigenaar van het ontwerp van een self-service KYC-studio bij Nect — waar B2B-klanten hun eigen identiteitsverificatie- en customer-due-diligence-flows configureren, branden en lanceren. 04HCI ResearchHCI-onderzoek

Big Screens, Bigger Challenges

Mobile Accessibility

A UX dive into smartphone reachability. As screens grow but the thumb’s reach stays constant, can accessibility features close the one-handed “dead zone”? A research study of prototypes, experiments and data analysis.Een UX-duik in de bereikbaarheid van smartphones. Schermen groeien, maar de duim niet — kunnen toegankelijkheidsfeatures de “dode zone” bij eenhandig gebruik dichten? Een onderzoek met prototypes, experimenten en data-analyse.

✦ ABOUT ME

a little about myself

My journey began in Psychology & Communication Sciences, where I was drawn to the intricate intersection of human behaviour and technology. That curiosity carried me into a Master's in Human–Computer Interaction, where I dug deeper into the symbiotic relationship between people and tech.

Now, in UX design, that background lets me approach problems with a holistic perspective. Lately I'm focused on bringing AI into both the products I design and the way I design them — setting up new tools and growing with them to prototype faster, fail early, and validate with users sooner.

Away from the screen, I find clarity scaling rock walls, hiking, and surfing.

Nadja.
